meaning.en: the sacred syllable Om, invoked at the start
meaning.hi: ॐ, आरंभ में लिया गया पवित्र अक्षर

meaning.en: in Brahmavarta, a sacred region
at the foot of the great Bhandira banyan tree
for a great, long sacrificial session
meaning.hi: एक महान, दीर्घ यज्ञ के लिए

meaning.en: the great sages, gathered together
led by Shaunaka
holding kindling sticks in their hands
eager to know the truth of things
to the sage Markandeya
who lived an extraordinarily long life
approached and asked
by what means do you live so long
meaning.hi: किस साधन से आप दीर्घजीवी हैं

meaning.en: and by what do you experience joy
meaning.hi: और किससे आनंद का अनुभव करते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: through the supreme secret knowledge of Shiva's truth
thus he said
what is that
who is the deity in it
what are the mantras
what is the chanting practice
what is the hand gesture
what is the inner discipline
what is the means of gaining this knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञान पाने का साधन क्या है

meaning.en: what supporting practice goes with it
what offering does it call for
what is the right time for it

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: what is that place
that through which the south-facing Shiva is directly realized
meaning.hi: जिससे दक्षिणमुखी शिव प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव किए जाते हैं

meaning.en: that is the supreme secret knowledge of Shiva's truth
one who, at the time beyond all else
meaning.hi: जो सबसे परे उस क्षण में

meaning.en: gathers everything back into the self
rests, radiant, in the joy of his own being
meaning.hi: अपने ही आनंद-सुख में रमता या प्रकाशित होता है

meaning.en: that is the deity
here come the secret verses of the mantra
meaning.hi: यहाँ मंत्र के गुप्त श्लोक आते हैं

meaning.en: for the Dakshinamurti mantra, the seer is Brahma
meaning.hi: दक्षिणामूर्ति मंत्र के ऋषि ब्रह्मा हैं

meaning.en: its meter is Gayatri
its deity is the south-facing one
placing the mantra on the limbs of the body
first uttering Om, then namah
then the word bhagavate
then the word dakshina
and finally draw out the word murtaye
meaning.hi: और अंत में 'मूर्तये' शब्द दीर्घ स्वर से उच्चारे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the word for oneself in its fourth grammatical case
one should say the words medha (intellect) and prajna (wisdom)

words.sanskrit: samuchcharya tato vayu-bijam chcham cha tatah pathet

meaning.en: then utter and recite the seed-sound of air, chham
meaning.hi: फिर वायु-बीज 'छं' का उच्चारण कर पढ़ें

meaning.en: then, joined to the seed of fire, this becomes
meaning.hi: फिर अग्नि-बीज से जुड़कर यह बनता है

meaning.en: the twenty-four syllable mantra

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: of crystal- or silver-like complexion
meaning.hi: स्फटिक अथवा चाँदी के समान वर्ण

meaning.en: wearing a rosary of pearls
holding the nectar-pot and the knowledge it stands for
meaning.hi: अमृत-कलश और विद्या को धारण किए

meaning.en: the knowledge-gesture at the fingertips of one hand
wearing a serpent as a belt
meaning.hi: सर्प को कटिबंध की तरह धारण किए

meaning.en: crowned with the moon
three-eyed
adorned with various ornaments
I praise Dakshinamurti
meaning.hi: मैं दक्षिणामूर्ति की स्तुति करता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the placing of the mantra on the body
first uttering the opening Vedic sound
meaning.hi: पहले वेद के आरंभिक स्वर का उच्चारण

meaning.en: with its first vowel and the breath-mark
then drawing out the five-syllable core
carrying the breath-mark within it
at the end drawing out the sacred syllable Om again
meaning.hi: अंत में ॐ को पुनः दीर्घ स्वर से उच्चारे

meaning.en: this is the nine-syllable mantra

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the hand gesture that grants blessing
he who holds an axe and a deer with his arms
meaning.hi: जो फरसा और मृग भुजाओं में धारण किए हैं

meaning.en: one arm resting on the knee
waist wrapped with a coiled serpent
seated beneath the banyan tree
matted hair fitted with a sliver of moon
fair as milk, three-eyed
meaning.hi: दूध-सा गौर वर्ण, तीन नेत्रों वाला

meaning.en: may the eldest one grant
surrounded by sages such as Shuka
may Shiva grant purity to our hearts
meaning.hi: शिव हमारे हृदय को शुद्ध करें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the mantra-placement from the Brahma-sage lineage
uttering Om, then the seed bram, then namah
meaning.hi: ॐ, फिर 'ब्रां' बीज, फिर नमः उच्चारकर

meaning.en: then maya, then the seed of speech, vagbhava
then uttering the word dakshina
then finally the word murtaye

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: after the phrase 'grant me knowledge'
one places the word connected to fire
meaning.hi: अग्नि से जुड़ा शब्द रखा जाता है

meaning.en: this eighteen-syllable mantra
is kept most guarded among all mantras
meaning.hi: सब मंत्रों में सर्वाधिक गोपनीय रखा गया है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whose whole body is pale with sacred ash
meaning.hi: जो सर्वांग भस्म से धवल हैं

meaning.en: wearing a sliver of the moon
lotus-hands holding the knowledge gesture, rosary, veena, and book
meaning.hi: कमल-हाथों में ज्ञानमुद्रा, माला, वीणा, पुस्तक

meaning.en: adorned with a yogic strap
seated on the seat of teaching
attended by the finest sages, ever gracious
meaning.hi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियों द्वारा सेवित, सदा प्रसन्न

meaning.en: a serpent by his side, wrapped in a tiger's skin
may Lord Dakshinamurti protect us always
meaning.hi: दक्षिणामूर्ति ईश सदैव हमारी रक्षा करें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the mantra-placement from the Brahma-sage lineage
uttering the highest Om, then the seed of Rama/Rama-devi
meaning.hi: परम प्रणव, फिर रमा-बीज का उच्चारण

meaning.en: and addressing it to Shiva together with his consort
meaning.hi: और साम्बशिव को संबोधित करते हुए

meaning.en: and to you, joined to the seed of fire
this twelve-syllable mantra

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: carrying veena, book, and rosary in his hands
meaning.hi: हाथों में वीणा, पुस्तक, अक्षमाला धारण किए

meaning.en: throat dark like a raincloud, richly adorned
meaning.hi: मेघ-सा श्याम कंठ, समृद्ध आभूषणों से युक्त

meaning.en: wearing the great serpent as a sacred thread
meaning.hi: महासर्प को यज्ञोपवीत की तरह धारण किए

meaning.en: served by sages such as Shuka
I praise him who made his dwelling beneath the banyan tree
meaning.hi: वटवृक्ष के नीचे निवास बनाए, उन्हें मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the seer is Vishnu, the meter is Anushtubh
the deity is the south-facing one
the placing of the mantra on the body
Om, salutation to you, the lord
then the word for the banyan tree
uttering the word mula, meaning root
and drawing out the word vasine, the one who dwells

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: after the words wisdom and intellect
one should say the phrase for primal accomplishment
uttering the word dayine, the one who gives
and drawing out namah to mayine, the one whose power is maya

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then to the lord of speech
then the phrase for great wisdom
then joined to the seed of fire, this becomes
meaning.hi: फिर अग्नि-बीज से जुड़कर यह बनता है

meaning.en: a thirty-two syllable mantra
in Anushtubh meter, the king among mantras
meaning.hi: अनुष्टुप् छंद में, मंत्रों का राजा

meaning.en: the very best of all mantras

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: arms bright with the knowledge gesture, book, fire, and serpent
meaning.hi: मुद्रा, पुस्तक, अग्नि, नाग से देदीप्यमान भुजाएँ

meaning.en: serene of face
adorned with a garland of pearls
crown shining with the crescent moon
the one who removes ignorance
the primal source of the earliest speech itself
meaning.hi: आदिम वाणी का भी मूल स्रोत

meaning.en: the husband of Bhavani
the supreme teacher dwelling beneath the banyan tree
meaning.hi: न्यग्रोध वृक्ष के नीचे निवास करने वाले परम गुरु

meaning.en: I meditate, so my true wish may be fulfilled
meaning.hi: मैं ध्यान करता हूँ, अपनी अभीष्ट प्राप्ति हेतु

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: remaining established in the thought 'I am that'
that is the highest devotion
repeating the mantra with the sense of non-difference is the means to knowledge
meaning.hi: उस अभेद-भाव से मंत्र-जप ज्ञान का साधन है

meaning.en: keeping the mind fixed, undivided, on that is the discipline
meaning.hi: चित्त की उसी पर एकाग्रता ही परिकर है

meaning.en: offering one's own bodily actions is the offering
meaning.hi: शरीर की चेष्टाओं का अर्पण ही बलि है

meaning.en: the three states of waking, dream, and deep sleep are its time
meaning.hi: तीन अवस्थाएँ (जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति) ही काल हैं

meaning.en: the point above the crown of the head is its seat

words.sanskrit: te ha punah shraddadhanah tam pratyuchuh

meaning.en: the faithful sages asked him again
how does its realization arise
what is its true nature
and who is its true worshipper
he answered
in a vessel filled with the oil of dispassion, fitted with the wick of devotion
meaning.hi: वैराग्य रूपी तेल से भरे, भक्ति रूपी बत्ती से युक्त पात्र में

meaning.en: one sees the lamp of understanding in the vessel of awakening
meaning.hi: प्रबोध रूपी पूर्ण पात्र में ज्ञप्ति-दीप देखा जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in the empty, worthless darkness of delusion
meaning.hi: मोह के खोखले, सारहीन अंधकार में

meaning.en: it rises entirely on its own
meaning.hi: यह पूर्णतः अपने आप उदित होता है

meaning.en: making dispassion the lower fire-stick
and knowledge the upper fire-stick

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: to bring peace to deep, thick darkness
meaning.hi: गहरे, घने अंधकार को शांत करने के लिए

meaning.en: one should reveal the hidden meaning
meaning.hi: गूढ़ अर्थ का निवेदन करना चाहिए

meaning.en: that which crosses beyond the reach of delusion's sun
meaning.hi: मोह-सूर्य की पहुँच से परे जाने वाला

meaning.en: is called discernment, born in Mrikandu's son
meaning.hi: विवेक कहलाता है, मृकण्डु-पुत्र में जन्मा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: bound by the knot of not examining the truth
tormented by the fear that comes from duality
reviving in one's own joy
meaning.hi: अपने ही आनंद में पुनर्जीवित करते हुए

meaning.en: abiding in one's own true nature

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the intelligence called dakshina, meaning skillful
meaning.hi: जो बुद्धि दक्षिणा कही गई है

meaning.en: whose gaze is turned constantly toward it
meaning.hi: जिसका मुख निरंतर उसी की ओर लगा है

meaning.en: is described by the knowers of Brahman as Shiva facing south
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मवेत्ताओं द्वारा दक्षिणाभिमुख शिव कहा गया है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: at the beginning of creation
the great lord Brahma, worshipping him
meaning.hi: भगवान ब्रह्मा ने इनकी उपासना करके

meaning.en: gained the power to create
his mind became content
and having obtained his desired ends
he was made fortunate; so does the worshipper who worships him become a creator
meaning.hi: वे धन्य हुए; इसी तरह उपासक भी सृष्टिकर्ता बन जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
